title: The Visitor of Harrow Glen
author: Bram Delacroix
blurb: Cyrus Eastwick, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
